title: A/R Summary: the Location chip reads all, a count, one name or none
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open A/R documents at three locations, {Location-A}, {Location-B} and {Location-C}; {Location-C}'s name is longer than the chip can show.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310 and {Location-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-13 Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Service Centre.
  • Starting screen: A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read the Location chip.
  2. In the Location menu, untick {Location-B}.
  3. Untick {Location-A}.
  4. Untick {Location-C}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Location: All locations".
  • Step 2: "Location: 2 locations".
  • Step 3: the chip reads "Location: " and {Location-C}'s name, shortened with "..." because it is long.
  • Step 4: "Location: No locations".

The Location chip is the native one, exactly as on Sales By Customer: with one location ticked, and for a long name, it reads as that chip does.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R6: “The chip reads "Location: All locations" when every location is ticked, the location's name when one is ticked (shortened with "..." when long), "Location: N locations" when N are ticked, and "Location: No locations" when none is.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

  • ar-ap-p4-the-native-location-menu.png: figure "The native Location menu" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"
  • ar-ap-p4-one-location-ticked.png: figure "One location ticked" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"

The design's own words:

  • ""Select all" with "2 selected", every location in this report's own data named as in the top-right switcher, then "Clear selection". S5-R2, S5-R3, S5-R4, S5-R5, S5-R6." (caption of "The native Location menu")
  • "One location ticked ("1 selected"): the chip names it, rows, totals and exports narrow to it, and the Location column hides. S5-R6, S5-R7, S5-R10, S6-N1." (caption of "One location ticked")
